random.description: Sends random catalog items and names at short, varying intervals, only while a match is active.

feedback.queued: The redeems were added to the queue.
feedback.queue_full: The queue reached its temporary limit.
feedback.sent: The item was sent into the fight.
feedback.spawn_failed: The item could not be created. Check the fight state.
